shots.seen: A man in dark clothing sits on a motorcycle on a rooftop overlooking blocky city buildings at night.
A man on a motorcycle looks out over a body of water, a distant city, and mountains under a starry dawn sky.

overall: Neither the third-person view nor the visual style is consistent across the shots, as the framing zooms in to crop the man's lower legs and the environment shifts from blocky low-poly shapes to a detailed landscape. The biggest weakness is the jarring visual transition between a rudimentary 3D grey-box city and a semi-realistic mountain backdrop.
